StatCompare is designed for gear checks and player comparisons. It provides detailed character and target gear stats, talents, buffs, enchants, and custom abilities, making it a valuable tool for raiders, guilds, and gear evaluators. == Installation == '''GitAddonsManager''' The easiest way to keep '''StatCompare''' up to date is by using [[GitAddonsManager]]. # '''Add the Repository:''' Add the following URL to GitAddonsManager: https://github.com/grimfiendish/StatCompare.git # '''Select the Branch:''' Ensure that the master branch is selected. # '''Update:''' Using GitAddonsManager, you can check for and install updates for all your AddOns with a single click. '''Manual Installation''' If you prefer manual installation, follow these steps: # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Unpack the .zip and rename the folder to StatCompare, removing the -master suffix. # Move the folder into your Interface/AddOns directory and restart the game. '''Optional''': [[BetterCharacterStats]] == Git Links == * [https://github.com/grimfiendish/StatCompare/ '''(grimfiendish)'''] == Commands == * '''Enable:''' /statc on * '''Disable:''' /statc off * '''Debug Mode on:''' /statc debug on * '''Debug Mode off:''' /statc debug off * '''Open Options:''' /statc config * '''Show Item Collection:''' /statc item * '''Compare Sets / Gear:''' /statc sets * '''Help & Info:''' /statc help == Usage == * '''View Your Own Stats:''' Use c key to open the stats panel for your character. * '''Gear Checks:''' Take screenshots of your gear or view detailed stats of inspection targets. * '''Selective Display:''' Toggle info with icons at the top-right: ** Armor & Enchants ** Spell Info ** Character Stats == Preview == Options: [[File:Sc1.png|frameless|401x401px]] StatCompare: [[File:Sc.png|frameless|405x405px]] == Features == * '''Character Stats & Resistances:''' Attack Power, Spell Power, Resistances, Hit, Crit, and more. * '''Gear & Enchants:''' Lists equipped items and their enchantments. * '''Talent Tree Summary:''' Shows your talent specialization. * '''Active Buffs:''' Displays current buffs that may influence stats. * '''Custom Abilities:''' Supports abilities like Haste, Vampirism, Crusader Strike. == Compatibility == * Works with standard WoW 1.12.1 client. * Supports private servers with custom abilities. * Adjustments may be needed for server-specific features. * Supports Chinese (zhCN) and English. == Credits == * '''Author:''' slashboy @ 九藜方舟 Dreamland * '''Modified & Maintained by:''' lasthime @ 艾森纳 * '''Contributors:''' 狗血编剧男, Provocateur @ TurtleWow == Version History == * '''v1.8.000:''' Added gear item names and enchant info for raid checks. * '''v1.7.010:''' Improved compatibility, fixed bug with armor type display, added shift-click to insert items into chat. * '''v1.7.005:''' Support for gear set bonuses, set property detection. * '''v1.6 & earlier:''' Supported detailed resistances, spell damage, and extensive passive bonuses, with support for private server abilities and custom enchantments. The mountains are traditionally the ancestral home of the [[Harpy|harpies]],[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_World_of_Warcraft_Townhall/Beastiary#Harpy The World of Warcraft Townhall/Beastiary#Harpy] but their numbers have dwindled as the bird-women spread east and south. [[Stonetalon Peak]], the largest mountain in the range, has long been a sacred place for both the [[Night elf|night elves]] and [[tauren]]. The night elves maintain a barrow and a glade at the top, where they commune regularly with the spirits of nature. The mountains further south are less forested, although some sparse evergreens grow in certain spots, particularly the [[Greatwood Vale]]. The [[Venture Company]] have put a heavy toll on the land, cutting down almost all the trees in [[Windshear Crag]] and filling the air with soot, spoiling the area's water with oil and waste. The tauren have a holding in the centrally located [[Sun Rock Retreat]] and the [[Darkspear]] trolls have a settlement further south at [[Malaka'jin]]. The mountains are also home to kobolds, spiders, and wyverns, while the [[Charred Vale]] holds several especially dangerous kinds of beasts and elementals. == Geography == The Stonetalon Mountains lie between the forests of [[Ashenvale]] to the north and the bleak [[Desolace]] to the south west. The highest peaks of the mountains are thickly forested with evergreens, though the forest thins with lower altitude. The logging of the [[Venture Company]] has also further thinned the forest, with clear cutting in and around [[Windshear Crag]]. The mountains boast a lake known as [[Mirkfallon Lake]], around which [[wyvern]]s make their nests. [[Charred Vale]], once a lush and beautiful area, is now a desolate ruin full of fire elementals. There are no instanced dungeons nor PvP battlegrounds in the Stonetalon Mountains. The micro dungeon [[Talon Den]] can be found here. Travel hubs include [[Sun Rock Retreat]] for the Horde and [[Stonetalon Peak]] and [[Bael Hardul]] for the Alliance. === Maps and subregions === [[File:WorldMap-StonetalonMountains.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Stonetalon Mountains]] WorldMap-StonetalonMountains-old3.jpg|Map of Stonetalon Mountains prior to [[patch 1.18.0]]. '''Stormwind Stockade''', also known as '''The Stockade''', is a heavily guarded prison in the middle of [[Stormwind City]]. A large number of dangerous criminals, including some criminal masterminds and Defias mercenaries, are currently being held in the stockade. However, not so long ago, there was a revolt inside the dungeon, and the prisoners now keep the Stockade under their control.

==History==
:''The Stockade is a high-security prison complex, hidden beneath the [[Canals (Stormwind City)|canal district]] of [[Stormwind]] city. Presided over by [[Warden Thelwater]], Stormwind Stockade is home to petty crooks, political insurgents, murderers and a score of the most dangerous criminals in the land. Recently, a prisoner-led revolt has resulted in a state of pandemonium within the stockade - where the guards have been driven out and the convicts roam free. Warden Thelwater has managed to escape the holding area and is currently enlisting brave thrill-seekers to venture into the prison and kill the uprising's mastermind - the cunning felon, [[Bazil Thredd]].''

It seems the prison was fairly inefficiently run, resorting to using least one [[Mac|teenage guard]] who got murdered when the prisoners revealed their allegiance to the [[Defias Brotherhood]].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|26D|The Color of Blood}}</ref> Several prisoners were sentenced to death, including the [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock]] [[orc]] [[Targorr the Dread]] and human grave-robber [[Dextren Ward]], but [[House of Nobles|bureaucratic nobles]] put a hold on them in a sort of foul play. As a result, both the [[Lakeshire]] guard,<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|25D|What Comes Around...}}</ref> [[Council of Darkshire]]<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|26D|Crime and Punishment}}</ref> and even the [[Ironforge (kingdom)|Kingdom of Ironforge]]<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|27D|The Fury Runs Deep}}</ref> sent agents to the prison to bypass Stormwindian bureaucracy and have prisoners assassinated.

[[Image:Stonewatch Keep.jpg|thumb|300px|Stonewatch Keep]]
'''Stonewatch Keep''' is the main structure of the human stronghold of [[Stonewatch]], which also includes the [[Stonewatch Tower]]. Originally, Stonewatch used to be controlled by the humans of [[Lakeshire]]. One day however, the warlock [[Morganth]] made an alliance with the [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock orcs]] led by [[Gath'Ilzogg]], and together they combined their forces to invade Redridge. Fueled by the evil magic of Morganth, the Blackrock orcs attacked Stonewatch Keep in Redridge with horrific savagery. Ultimately, they captured Stonewatch Keep, but shortly after their victory, Morganth turned on his orcish cohorts. He constructed an arcane tower, the [[Tower of Ilgalar]], and used his powers to build a small army of [[Shadowhide clan|Shadowhide]] gnolls led by [[Lieutenant Fangore]], to serve his malicious bidding. Both orc and man have fallen victim to the brutes that serve Morganth.<ref>[[The State of Lakeshire]]</ref>

Left to fend for themselves, the orcs of the Blackrock clan maintained control of the keep, which was overseen by the Blackrock warlord [[Gath'Ilzogg]] and his trusted lieutenant, [[Tharil'zun]]. Having taken [[Corporal Keeshan]] of the [[Stormwind Army]] prisoner during the battle, they dragged him away to their encampments further north.<ref>[[Missing: Corporal Keeshan]]</ref>

[[Magistrate Solomon]] has put a bounty on Gath'Ilzogg<ref>{{Alliance}} [26+] [[Wanted: Gath'Ilzogg (quest)]]</ref> while [[Marshal Marris]] of [[Lakeshire]] enlists the aid of [[Alliance]] [[adventurer]]s to hunt down and kill Tharil'zun for his misdeeds.<ref>{{Alliance}} [25] [[Tharil'zun (quest)]]</ref>

'''Stonetalon Peak'''{{coords|43|16|Stonetalon Mountains}} is an [[Alliance]] settlement at the far northern end of the [[Stonetalon Mountains]] region. It is built within a verdant mountain valley, or [[Green Havens|Green Haven]], and is maintained by the [[Druids]] of the nearby [[Talon Den]]. It has the only Alliance [[vendor]]s and [[flight path]] in the zone. It also contains a [[Moonwell]].

This forested peak is a glimpse at what the entire region of Stonetalon looked like before the goblins and elementals arrived. Here, one can find the only Alliance outpost, lead by a night elf named [[Albagorn]]. The elves here are assisted in their efforts to reclaim the mountains by dryads and mighty keepers of the grove. A barrow den is also located here, where some druids lie sleeping, connecting to the Emerald Dream. The peak is highest point in the mountain range. It was actually made hollow with numerous eruptions in the great Sundering. The caves have become home to several wayward beasts, which gain entrance through an opening in the south. The Horde knows of their leader Thrall's passage through the legendary caves, but he explored only one of the many twisting routes of empty lava tubes that fill Stonetalon Peak.

The '''Stormrage Barrow Dens''' are the sacred [[Barrow Den]]s of [[Moonglade]] where many of the [[Night Elf]] [[Druid]]s slumber in the [[Emerald Dream]].  The great druid [[Malfurion Stormrage]], for whom the Barrow Dens are named, slumbers deep within the dens.  Tragically, sometime after the [[Third War]], Malfurion became lost somewhere within the Emerald Dream. 

The north-eastern corner of Moonglade holds the Barrow Dens. This area is sacred to the druids and was also formerly the home of the late demigod Cenarius. The Barrow Dens are an ancient underground fortress, with passages and caves containing the living and working chambers for the [[Druids of the Wild]]. The dome in the center of the hill holds [[Cenarius' Lair]], now a shrine to the valiant demigod.

During the Third War, Malfurion was awakened by [[Tyrande]] to help fight [[Archimonde]]'s forces.  He was sleeping in his Barrow Den.  He was almost destroyed by the [[Nathrezim|Dreadlord]] [[Tichondrius]]' forces.

Directly north of the Barrow Dens are [[Minion of Omen|Minions of Omen]], high level wolf-like creatures.  They only come out at night during the Lunar Festival.

Present our triumph to the Warchief, and tell him I will soon return. Perhaps I will visit Hellscream's memorial when I do. ==Rewards== You will receive: * 2500 XP == Progress == Lok'tar ogar. == Completion == Though it is not bound to be the last time we see the embers of the Shadow Council, a great victory was won. While we wish nothing from the land of Balor, it has given me the greatest gift. Kilrogg was spiteful in the beginning, jealous of Grommash's celebration as a hero—while he himself seemed forgotten. But he was wrong to envy Grommash. My older brother merely set the foundation. It is you, and I, and Kilrogg who will build our future. I am glad he sees it that way now. == Progression == {{Storm's End}} ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.18.0|note=Added.}}

== Description ==
The Stormreaver Clan was not composed solely of orcs from the Shadow Council, but also included the ogre magi who served under Cho'Gall. While a questionable ally, Gul'dan kept that two-headed buffoon as close as he could. I do wonder if the reason was that he knew they would one day betray each other in their lust for power.

Alas, one failed while the other lives—hiding beneath the sands, behind the cloak of a cult that worships myths and legends as old as this world. I have taken the liberty of making the succubi share their plans with me. To the west, past the cave where you defeated her, you will find the Windrock Cliffs. It is there that a member of the Twilight's Hammer holds a fragment of the key. Slay him and return with whatever you find.
